+# Check if a global link option is supported. The caller must pass
+# a unique var name per flag which is used to create a cmake cache
+# entry that stores whether the flag is supported or not.
+function(add_link_options_if_supported flag var)
+  check_linker_flag(C "LINKER:${flag}" ${var})
+  if(${var})
     add_link_options("LINKER:${flag}")
   else()
     message(WARNING "Attempted to use unsupported link option : ${flag}.")
   endif()
 endfunction()
